Definition: the leg or shoulder (of man or beast); the priest's shoulder portion
BiblicalUsage: Shoq is the leg, and it is also the shoulder, the joint where strength meets the body. The priest's portion of the peace offering was the right shoulder, Samuel set the shoulder before Saul as the honoured guest's share, and the Song praises legs like pillars of marble. The word moves between the animal's shoulder on the altar and the man's leg on the road.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gives the best portion to His servants and His guests, and the Lord still honours those who serve Him with the best of what He has.
